verdict.rationale: New Relic offers substantial programmatic surfaces. NerdGraph is a GraphQL API with an explorer, NRQL supports querying and alert setup, and there is an official CLI, Terraform support and an official MCP server. However, its own docs say NerdGraph can configure only "some" New Relic features, which undercuts full UI parity, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of all UI features (e.g. dashboards, SLOs, notifications), an explicit API-parity statement, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of API completeness.
